# Multi-Stage Dockerfile for Node.js TypeScript Application

## Project Structure
```
project/
├── src/
│   └── index.ts
├── package.json
├── package-lock.json
├── tsconfig.json
└── Dockerfile
```

## Dockerfile

```dockerfile
# ============================================================
# Stage 1: Base — shared foundation with common configuration
# ============================================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS base

# Set working directory for all subsequent stages
WORKDIR /app

# Install dumb-init for proper signal handling and PID 1 management
# This ensures graceful shutdowns work correctly in containers
RUN apk add --no-cache dumb-init

# ============================================================
# Stage 2: Dependencies — install ALL dependencies (dev + prod)
# ============================================================
FROM base AS dependencies

# Copy only package files first to leverage Docker layer caching.
# This layer is only invalidated when package files change,
# not when source code changes.
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./

# Install all dependencies including devDependencies (needed for TypeScript)
# --frozen-lockfile ensures reproducible builds
RUN npm ci --frozen-lockfile

# ============================================================
# Stage 3: Builder — compile TypeScript to JavaScript
# ============================================================
FROM dependencies AS builder

# Copy TypeScript configuration
COPY tsconfig.json ./

# Copy source code
COPY src/ ./src/

# Compile TypeScript to JavaScript
# Output goes to /app/dist as configured in tsconfig.json
RUN npm run build

# ============================================================
# Stage 4: Production Dependencies — install only prod packages
# ============================================================
FROM base AS production-dependencies

COPY package.json package-lock.json ./

# Install ONLY production dependencies, skipping devDependencies
# This creates a clean, minimal node_modules for the final image
RUN npm ci --frozen-lockfile --omit=dev

# ============================================================
# Stage 5: Final — minimal production image
# ============================================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS final

# Install dumb-init in the final stage as well
RUN apk add --no-cache dumb-init

# Create a non-root user and group for security
# Running as root in containers is a security risk
RUN addgroup --system --gid 1001 nodejs && \
    adduser  --system --uid 1001 --ingroup nodejs nodeuser

WORKDIR /app

# Copy production node_modules from the production-dependencies stage
COPY --from=production-dependencies --chown=nodeuser:nodejs /app/node_modules ./node_modules

# Copy compiled JavaScript from the builder stage
# We only need the dist/ folder — no source TypeScript files
COPY --from=builder --chown=nodeuser:nodejs /app/dist ./dist

# Copy package.json for runtime metadata (version, scripts, etc.)
COPY --chown=nodeuser:nodejs package.json ./

# Switch to non-root user
USER nodeuser

# Expose the application port
EXPOSE 3000

# Set NODE_ENV to production for optimized runtime behavior
ENV NODE_ENV=production

# Health check to verify the application is running correctly
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=15s --retries=3 \
    CMD node -e "require('http').get('http://localhost:3000/health', (r) => { process.exit(r.statusCode === 200 ? 0 : 1) })"

# Use dumb-init as the entrypoint to handle signals properly
# This prevents zombie processes and ensures clean shutdowns
ENTRYPOINT ["dumb-init", "--"]

# Start the compiled application
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

## Supporting Files

### tsconfig.json
```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "commonjs",
    "lib": ["ES2022"],
    "outDir": "./dist",
    "rootDir": "./src",
    "strict": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "declaration": true,
    "declarationMap": false,
    "sourceMap": false
  },
  "include": ["src/**/*"],
  "exclude": ["node_modules", "dist"]
}
```

### package.json
```json
{
  "name": "my-ts-app",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc --project tsconfig.json",
    "start": "node dist/index.js",
    "dev": "ts-node src/index.ts",
    "lint": "eslint src/**/*.ts",
    "test": "jest"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "express": "^4.18.2"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/express": "^4.17.21",
    "@types/node": "^20.10.0",
    "typescript": "^5.3.2"
  }
}
```

### .dockerignore
```
# Dependencies — always reinstalled inside Docker
node_modules/

# Build output — rebuilt inside Docker
dist/

# Version control
.git/
.gitignore

# Docker files themselves
Dockerfile
.dockerignore

# Development and test files
*.test.ts
*.spec.ts
__tests__/
coverage/

# Environment files (use secrets/env vars at runtime)
.env
.env.*
!.env.example

# Editor and OS files
.vscode/
.idea/
*.DS_Store
Thumbs.db

# Logs
logs/
*.log
npm-debug.log*

# CI/CD
.github/
.gitlab-ci.yml
```

## Build and Run Commands

```bash
# Build the image
docker build -t my-ts-app:latest .

# Build with a specific target stage (useful for debugging)
docker build --target builder -t my-ts-app:debug .

# Run the container
docker run -p 3000:3000 --env-file .env my-ts-app:latest

# Run with resource limits (recommended for production)
docker run \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  --env-file .env \
  --memory="256m" \
  --cpus="0.5" \
  --read-only \
  --tmpfs /tmp \
  my-ts-app:latest

# Inspect image layers and size
docker image inspect my-ts-app:latest
docker history my-ts-app:latest
```

## Stage Summary

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     Build Pipeline                              │
├──────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Stage                │ Purpose                                  │
├──────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ base                 │ Shared Alpine + dumb-init foundation     │
│ dependencies         │ All deps (dev + prod) for compilation    │
│ builder              │ TypeScript → JavaScript compilation      │
│ production-deps      │ Only production deps, no devDependencies │
│ final                │ Minimal image: compiled JS + prod deps   │
└──────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────┘

What's EXCLUDED from the final image:
  ✗ TypeScript source files (src/)
  ✗ TypeScript compiler (tsc)
  ✗ devDependencies (@types/*, typescript, etc.)
  ✗ tsconfig.json
  ✗ Test files and coverage reports
  ✗ Root user privileges
```

## Key Optimizations Explained

| Technique | Benefit |
|---|---|
| `node:20-alpine` base | ~170MB vs ~1GB for full Debian image |
| Multi-stage builds | Dev tools never reach the final image |
| `COPY package*.json` first | Layer cache reused when only source changes |
| `npm ci --omit=dev` | Excludes TypeScript, type definitions, test tools |
| Non-root user | Reduces attack surface |
| `dumb-init` | Proper PID 1 signal handling, no zombie processes |
| `.dockerignore` | Prevents unnecessary files entering build context |
| `sourceMap: false` | Smaller dist output, no source exposure |
